#include <iostream>

#include <string>

#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

class FastReader {
public:
    string next() {
        while (buffer.str().empty() || buffer.eof()) {
            getline(cin, line);
            buffer.str(line);
            buffer.clear();
        }
        string token;
        buffer >> token;
        return token;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }

    string nextLine() {
        getline(cin, line);
        buffer.str("");
        buffer.clear();
        return line;
    }

private:
    string line;
    stringstream buffer;
};

FastReader s;
// PrintWriter equivalent: using cout directly, but we'll create a string ans and output at end.
// We'll not use a global PrintWriter object; we'll append to a string and print at end.

static int gcd(int a, int b) {
    if (b == 0) return a;
    return gcd(b, a % b);
}

static vector<int> rai(int n) {
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        arr[i] = s.nextInt();
    }
    return arr;
}

static vector<vector<int>> rai(int n, int m) {
    vector<vector<int>> arr(n, vector<int>(m));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            arr[i][j] = s.nextInt();
        }
    }
    return arr;
}

static vector<long long> ral(int n) {
    vector<long long> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        arr[i] = s.nextLong();
    }
    return arr;
}

static vector<vector<long long>> ral(int n, int m) {
    vector<vector<long long>> arr(n, vector<long long>(m));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            arr[i][j] = s.nextLong();
        }
    }
    return arr;
}

static int ri() {
    return s.nextInt();
}

static long long rl() {
    return s.nextLong();
}

static string rs() {
    return s.next();
}

static int bsearch(const vector<long long>& list, long long val, int ind) {
    int l = ind, r = (int)list.size() - 1;
    int res = (int)list.size();
    while (l <= r) {
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        if (list[mid] > val) {
            if (mid == 0) {
                return mid;
            }
            if (list[mid - 1] <= val) {
                return mid;
            }
            r = mid - 1;
        } else {
            l = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    return res;
}

struct Node {
    int ind;
    long long val;
    Node(int i, long long v) : ind(i), val(v) {}
};

static long long calc(vector<Node>& list, vector<long long>& b, int i) {
    if (i == 3) {
        return 0;
    }

    // first branch: subtract from b[(first.ind-1) % 3] first
    Node first = list[i];
    int bInd = (first.ind - 1 + 3) % 3;
    long long min1 = min(first.val, b[bInd]);
    first.val -= min1;
    b[bInd] -= min1;

    long long min2 = min(first.val, b[first.ind]);
    first.val -= min2;
    b[first.ind] -= min2;
    long long sum = first.val;
    sum += calc(list, b, i + 1);
    // restore
    first.val += min1 + min2;
    b[bInd] += min1;
    b[first.ind] += min2;

    // second branch: subtract from b[first.ind] first
    first = list[i];
    bInd = (first.ind - 1 + 3) % 3;
    min1 = min(first.val, b[first.ind]);
    first.val -= min1;
    b[first.ind] -= min1;

    min2 = min(first.val, b[bInd]);
    first.val -= min2;
    b[bInd] -= min2;
    long long sum2 = first.val;
    sum2 += calc(list, b, i + 1);
    // restore
    first.val += min1 + min2;
    b[bInd] += min2;
    b[first.ind] += min1;

    return min(sum, sum2);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);

    string ans = "";
    int t = 1;
    while (t-- > 0) {
        int n = ri();
        vector<long long> a = ral(3);
        vector<long long> b = ral(3);

        long long max_val = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0]);
        long long min_val = max(0LL, a[0] + b[1] - n) + max(0LL, a[1] + b[2] - n) + max(0LL, a[2] + b[0] - n);
        ans += to_string(min_val) + " " + to_string(max_val) + "\n";
    }
    cout << ans;
    cout.flush();
    return 0;
}
